results.evidence: The lamp, blue exterior opening, warm inner slab, blue outer slab, differently oriented jamb faces and warm/cool hair highlights make more than three consistent receiving surfaces assessable.
results.expected_relation: Warm source illuminates near-facing stone, face and sleeve; blue window light cools far floor, opposite jamb face and hair rim.
results.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Both visible sources and at least three consistent receiving faces are assessable; contradictory cast placement fails.

results.evidence: The same threshold-linked stone/slab path remains readable through the open doorway. Its joints, mottle and geometry continue while the inner region is warm and the exposed wet outer region is blue. The metal threshold forms a physical boundary rather than unrelated swatches.
results.expected_relation: One recognizably continuous neutral limestone floor changes apparent colour as it passes through the open threshold.
results.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Continuous floor texture/form crosses boundary and cast changes with room exposure; partial or invisible continuity fails.

results.evidence: Ivory striped knit, charcoal apron, neutral-looking stone/plaster and two compact brick-red regions have identifiable carriers. Blue belongs chiefly to the externally illuminated receiving region, not a blue-painted costume.
results.expected_relation: Ivory/charcoal knit, gray stone/plaster and two brick-red object surfaces retain their respective intrinsic identity.
results.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Identify each carrier and source-dependent cast separately; a missing or misassigned carrier fails.

results.evidence: Architecture and stone floor form the broad dominant field; ivory knit is a secondary bounded light region; the red toolbox and tiny apron tab are contained accents. The visually blue exterior is part of the receiving environment, while the intrinsic carrier roles remain legible.
results.expected_relation: Neutral architecture/floor dominates, ivory garment is secondary, red tab/toolbox remain small accents.
results.native_pixel_pass_criterion: The neutral field is visibly largest and the red pair stays compact; any role inversion fails.

results.evidence: The ribbed knit and charcoal horizontal stripes follow fabric folds; matte canvas, painted-steel toolbox and reflective latch differ convincingly. The tiny apron tab is red and carries white letter-shaped marks, but its woven fibre texture cannot be established at the native 1312x1199 scale. With every expected material required and partial_is_fail, this is a failed broader test predicate.
results.expected_relation: Matte charcoal apron, ribbed ivory/charcoal knit, painted steel toolbox, woven red tab and satin latch show distinct behaviours.
results.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Fabric stripes follow cloth and materials have differentiated texture/reflection; absent material distinction fails.

results.evidence: Warm and blue regions align with two visible light environments. Gray stone structure, neutral/ivory material boundaries, charcoal fabric and brick-red object identity survive; a full-frame warm or blue wash is not the observed result.
results.expected_relation: Restrained rendering preserves local casts and midtone detail.
results.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Both source regions remain locally different with plausible neutral shadows; a uniform stylized grade fails.

results.evidence: The short dark bob with wispy fringe and the face eye/nose/lip proportions visibly resemble the supplied portrait at a downward three-quarter angle. This is appearance resemblance only and establishes no actual identity or biography.
results.expected_relation: Visible facial proportions and short dark bob with wispy fringe are recognizable as appearance guidance.
results.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Visual resemblance assessed only from face/hair at the rendered angle; metadata never establishes actual identity.

results.evidence: A kneeling worker, fingertip on the threshold strip, bracing palm, nearby toolbox and rain-beaded open door form one readable doorway-maintenance scene. Wet paving outside supplies the practical weather context. The exact last millimetres of seating remain an inferred action phase rather than a measurable before/after proof.
results.expected_relation: One worker seats a weather strip while outer moisture explains the practical need.
results.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Hand-strip contact and open threshold are legible with environmental rain traces; ambiguity is recorded as failure.

repair_decision.reason: The concrete remaining broader-test defect is unresolvable weave detail on a tiny decorative tab. No selected optical or embodiment gate requires repair; the default single call is retained.
